nodes.name: .checkstyle
nodes.summary: Eclipse Checkstyle plugin configuration enabling Sun-style Java checks with file-match pattern across the entire project.

nodes.name: .classpath
nodes.summary: Eclipse classpath file defining the src source folder, JRE container, and library dependencies including LWJGL, Slick, and other game engine jars.

nodes.name: .project
nodes.summary: Eclipse project descriptor for the JavaRA project with Java nature and Checkstyle builder configuration.

nodes.name: org.eclipse.jdt.core.prefs
nodes.summary: Eclipse JDT core formatter preferences defining code style rules for indentation, brace placement, whitespace, and line wrapping across the Java codebase.

nodes.name: org.eclipse.jdt.ui.prefs
nodes.summary: Eclipse JDT UI preferences for code cleanup actions, import ordering, and member visibility thresholds used by automated refactoring.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Ignore patterns for the Understand-Anything code analysis tool, listing build directories and test file patterns to exclude from analysis.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Configuration for the Understand-Anything code analysis tool, setting English as the output language for generated documentation and summaries.

nodes.name: allies.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing allied forces asset data including unit graphics, terrain, and UI elements for the allied faction.

nodes.name: conquer.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing core conquest-mode assets including main menu graphics, sidebar UI, and gameplay icons.

nodes.name: general.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing general-purpose asset data shared across game modes and factions.

nodes.name: hires.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing high-resolution graphics assets for enhanced display modes.

nodes.name: interface.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing user interface assets including buttons, panels, fonts, and HUD elements.

nodes.name: interior.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing interior terrain tile graphics for underground or building interior maps.

nodes.name: mouse.shp
nodes.summary: Westwood sprite shape file containing mouse cursor graphics including pointer, selection, and action cursor frames.

nodes.name: 00000005.pal
nodes.summary: Westwood palette file defining the color lookup table for the default game rendering palette (index 5).

nodes.name: egopal.pal
nodes.summary: Westwood EGA palette file providing the 16-color EGA-compatible color scheme for legacy display modes.

nodes.name: interior.pal
nodes.summary: Westwood palette file defining the color scheme for interior/underground terrain rendering.

nodes.name: snow.pal
nodes.summary: Westwood palette file defining the color scheme for snow terrain rendering in Arctic-themed maps.

nodes.name: temperat.pal
nodes.summary: Westwood palette file defining the color scheme for temperate terrain rendering in standard maps.

nodes.name: redalert.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing Red Alert expansion campaign assets including mission-specific graphics and data.

nodes.name: russian.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing Soviet/Russian forces asset data including unit graphics and structures for the Soviet faction.

nodes.name: scores.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing music and score assets including background tracks and victory/defeat themes.

nodes.name: snow.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing snow terrain tile graphics and Arctic-theme assets.

nodes.name: sounds.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing sound effects assets including weapon sounds, explosions, alerts, and unit responses.

nodes.name: speech.mix
nodes.summary: Westwood game archive containing voice-over speech assets including mission briefings, unit responses, and event announcements.
